alt.en: An engraved bust shows Béhanzin holding a long pipe, with a patterned cloth over one shoulder.
alt.zh: 版画半身像中的贝汉津手持长烟斗，花纹织物披在一侧肩上。

caption.en: Béhanzin holds a pipe in an undated wood engraving after a photograph taken following his surrender.
caption.zh: 未纪年木刻中的贝汉津手持烟斗；底本照片摄于他投降之后。

interpretation.en: The printed account places the captive king aboard a French warship. Portrait and caption show how the conquest of Dahomey was presented to a colonial audience.
interpretation.zh: 版面记述把被拘禁的国王置于法国军舰上。肖像与文字共同显示殖民读者如何接触达荷美被征服的消息。

alt.en: Brougham faces a group of Black figures while children beside a smoking factory appeal to him from behind.
alt.zh: 布鲁厄姆面朝一群黑人形象，身后冒烟工厂旁的儿童向他呼吁。

caption.en: Henry Heath places Brougham between racist caricatures of emancipated people and protesting factory children.
caption.zh: 亨利·希思把布鲁厄姆置于遭种族主义丑化的获解放者形象与抗议的工厂儿童之间。

interpretation.en: The speech bubbles make emancipation and factory reform competing claims on attention. They express the satirist’s argument, not the depicted people’s testimony. The tentative catalogue date, 1832?, conflicts with the reference to compensation under the 1833 abolition legislation; the year remains unresolved.
interpretation.zh: 对白把殖民地解放与工厂改革表现为争夺关注的诉求。这是讽刺画作者的论点，不是图中人物的证言。馆藏暂定的1832年？与画中涉及1833年废奴立法赔偿的文字冲突，年份仍未确定。

alt.en: Women and children stand beside large carding machines, driving belts and tall cylindrical containers.
alt.zh: 妇女与儿童站在大型梳棉机、传动带和高筒形容器旁。

caption.en: Women and children operate cotton-carding machines in this 1840 print after J. R. Barfoot.
caption.zh: 这幅1840年依据J.R.巴富特作品制作的版画，描绘妇女与儿童操作梳棉机。

interpretation.en: Belts and cylinders organize a sequence of tasks performed by the workers. The later print shows the workplace addressed by factory reform, while working hours and enforcement require written records.
interpretation.zh: 传动带与滚筒组织起工人完成的一系列操作。这幅较晚的版画呈现工厂改革所针对的劳动场所，工时与执法情况则需结合文字档案。

在古巴近海截获“埃米利亚”号

alt.en: Several sailing ships and small boats gather around a large vessel beneath a clouded sky.
alt.zh: 多艘帆船和小艇聚集在一艘大船周围，天空布满云层。

caption.en: An 1858 engraving shows the Royal Navy intercepting the slave ship Emilia off Cuba, after an officer’s sketch.
caption.zh: 1858年版画依据军官速写，描绘英国海军在古巴近海截获贩奴船“埃米利亚”号。

interpretation.en: The ships dominate the composition; the people being transported are almost invisible. This naval view documents an Atlantic trade that continued after Britain abolished its own slave trade.
interpretation.zh: 舰船占据构图中心，被运送者几乎不可见。这幅海军视角的图像记录了英国废除本国奴隶贸易后仍在继续的大西洋贩运。

title.zh: 同一画面中的拉合尔与统治者

alt.en: A coloured panorama labels Lahore’s citadel and royal mosque above a small mounted procession.
alt.zh: 彩色全景在小型骑乘队伍上方，标注拉合尔的城堡与皇家清真寺。

caption.en: An undated northern view of Lahore places Ranjit Singh, identified by the catalogue, in the foreground.
caption.zh: 未纪年的拉合尔北面景观把馆藏所辨识的兰季特·辛格置于前景。

interpretation.en: Named buildings extend across the skyline while a small procession occupies the foreground. The composition links the ruler with the kingdom’s urban capital.
interpretation.zh: 具名建筑沿天际线延伸，前景则是一支小队伍。构图把统治者同王国都城连接起来。
